environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'services' with default service account. Pod has unrestricted egress via Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (allow-all default). IAM role attached via IRSA (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/webhook-service-role) has DynamoDB read/write on tables 'tenants' and 'webhook_events' with no leading-key conditions. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) enabled on underlying EC2 nodes. No egress proxy or URL filtering configured. VPC security group allows all outbound traffic.
